rationale: The cited headers place Principal/Shares immediately before Cost and Market Value, while cited holding rows show the first post-maturity numeric value is the principal or share quantity and the next values are Cost and Market Value. This supports a column remap from unified cost to unified principal_amount for the skipped Principal/Shares extraction.
